system.description:
A silvery magical metal found in wild, low-gravity places, flowing through the rock in sculpted veins; its items are remarkably light and built for mobility. It follows the general magical-material rules (counts as Best, one hearthstone slot, magical damage).

Melee weapons get +1k1 on attack and parry tests; ranged weapons suffer no penalty for firing heavy weapons unbraced or using a basic weapon one-handed; special ammunition doubles its range and loading it takes only a free action; armour has its Max Dex raised by 2. A bionic arm turns one Ready action each round into a free action and adds +1k1 to Dexterity tests and parries, while bionic legs give +4 Speed and +1k1 on Acrobatics, and a bionic heart gives an extra reaction each round.
system.effectText: Melee +1k1 attack/parry; ranged ignores bracing/one-hand penalties; ammo free-action load, double range; armour MaxDex +2; bionic bonuses.
